title: Pilobol.us CMS build fails: Markus brand prerenders Next reader routes
description: CMS Amplify app dv0pdx67fk80m builds fail since published articles exist in the backend: generateArticleStaticParams lists slugs from GraphQL, then app/articles/[slug]/page.tsx calls getSiteRenderer(), which throws MarkusSiteRendererError for Markus brands. Fix: Markus brands return [] from reader generateStaticParams and reader pages notFound().

comments.author: home
comments.text: Root cause: job 5 (next.12) generated 5 static pages; job 7 (next.15) generated 15. Published articles now exist in the backend, so `generateArticleStaticParams` (GraphQL listArticleSlugs) returns slugs and `/articles/[slug]` throws MarkusSiteRendererError for brand pilobol-us. Fix: PR https://github.com/AnthusAI/Papyrus/pull/139 on branch feature/PPY-dc5273-markus-no-next-reader-routes (Markus brands return [] and notFound()). Verified locally with a scaffold build: before 15 pages exit 1, with fixed files overlaid 5 pages exit 1->0. Follow-ups: merge, release next.16, bump Pilobol.us pin, rebuild CMS.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Pilobol.us PR https://github.com/AnthusAI/Pilobol.us/pull/52 pins @anthusai/papyrus 1.0.0-next.16 / papyrus-newsroom 1.0.0.dev16. Local next build exit 0. Reader stack AmplifyAppShell-pilobol-us updated (buildspec dev15 -> dev16 only). Awaiting merge, which triggers CMS + reader builds.

right_now_summary: A fix is ready and awaits merge before the CMS and reader builds can run.
